newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 4.36 million barrels in the week ended June 27 to 317.96 million barrels from 322.32 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 615,000 barrels in the week to 254.49 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 4.02 million barrels to 116.65 million barrels from 112.63 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.91 million barrels to 40.74 million barrels.
It said gasoline production fell 154,000 barrels per day in the week to 8.10 million bpd from 8.25 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.23 million barrels in the week to 204.23 million barrels from 205.47 million.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 96.9 percent from 97.6 percent the prior week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 966,000 barrels to 42.91 million barrels from 41.94 million barrels the previous week.
API also said refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 fell to 97.8 percent in the week from 98.1 percent the previous week.
API said total crude runs to processing units fell to 14.99 million barrels per day from 15.05 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 41.20 million barrels from 40.14 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.06 million barrels per day from 7.63 million, API said.
